input: Write the footer for a slide built on a public industry survey of 900 retailers from 2026 plus our own analysis.
expected_output: Note: n = 900 retailers. Source: Industry retail survey (2026); team analysis
bad_output: Data from survey and internal work
human_note: Does the note come before the source, and is the base (n) stated for survey data?
why: Unsourced numbers destroy a deck's credibility; a fixed format makes the check mechanical.
